facts.text: I want healthy, plant-based meal ideas for children.
I am not sure my kids will actually want to eat the meal ideas I receive.
I struggle with getting my kids to eat their veggies.
I plan to try some of the meal ideas for my kids.
I think making it fun for my kids will make a big difference in getting them excited about trying new things.
I might try making some of these ideas for myself too.
